prov:action:
#########
# GDSC ETL is performed in two steps: shell script to ETL data into postgres
# and then additional transformations with SQL in postGIS (if needed).
####

#########
# Step 1 - bash script (pseudo code)
####

# create directory structure and move into it
mkdir -p /data/us_2020_zcta/download -p /data/us_2020_zcta/etl
chmod -R 777 /data/us_2020_zcta
cd /data/us_2020_zcta

# set update flag based on last update and update frequency
do_update=0 if date() < last_update + update_frequency else do_update = 1

# download if update flag is set:
if do_update == 1 then
wget --retry-connrefused --waitretry=1 --read-timeout=20 --timeout=15 -t 10 -O download/us_2020_zcta.zip 'ftp://ftp2.census.gov/geo/tiger/TIGER2020/ZCTA520/tl_2020_us_zcta520.zip' 2>&1

# unzip to download directory if update flag is set
if do_update == 1 then
unzip -o download/us_2020_zcta.zip -d download && rm download/us_2020_zcta.zip 2>&1

# load into postGIS with:
ogr2ogr -lco GEOMETRY_NAME=geom -f PostgreSQL PG:"<postgres connection>" download/tl_2020_us_zcta520.shp -nlt multipolygon -nln us_2020_zcta
echo success: tl_2020_us_zcta520.shp loaded with ogr2ogr


#########
# Step 2 - SQL script (pseudo code):
####

# remove duplicate points and make geometries valid:
UPDATE us_2020_zcta
  SET geom=ST_MakeValid(ST_RemoveRepeatedPoints(geom));

# add local geometry column and reproject existing geometries into local EPSG:
ALTER TABLE us_2020_zcta DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS geom_local CASCADE;
SELECT AddGeometryColumn (
  'us_2020_zcta',
  'geom_local', 4269, 'multipolygon', 2
);
UPDATE us_2020_zcta
  SET geom_local=ST_MakeValid(ST_RemoveRepeatedPoints(ST_Transform(ST_Multi(geom),4269)));
CREATE INDEX us_2020_zcta_geom_local_idx
  ON us_2020_zcta
  USING GIST (geom_local);
NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';
